# Triviolivia

> Earth's deepest trivia source — a free say-aloud trivia game with thousands of questions across 25 categories, 5 difficulty levels, and 12 historical eras. No signup required; play instantly in any browser.

Triviolivia is a browser-based party trivia game designed for the say-aloud format: a question appears, players call out their answer, and the answer reveals on a timer. Solo or group play, with rich category, difficulty, and era controls.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Start a game, configure categories/difficulties/eras, and learn how to play.
